name: ordinary matter action-domain component
statement: Dq_matter here means direct hidden/representative dependence in S_matter beyond psi, g_obs and theta_obs.
guard: source weights and readout projectors are assigned to other live components

name: matter descent chain-rule zero
statement: If S_matter=Sbar[psi,g_obs(q),theta_obs] and theta_obs is fixed as in 4264, then delta_v S_matter has no direct Dq_matter term.

name: matter C1 silence
statement: If the matter action-domain is the same on the compact collar and no hidden environment/matter field enters before variation, then nabla(Dq_matter)=0.
guard: fails for spatially varying direct matter couplings

name: source-prefactor split
statement: Terms of the form w_A(Phi) S_A, measured-source maps, worldtube projectors and coefficient normalizations are not part of the closed Dq_matter row; they remain in Dq_source_readout, Dq_coeff or boundary/projector rows.

name: direct matter deformation bound
statement: If S_matter contains hidden direct couplings before variation, retain epsilon_matter_direct <= ||delta_v S_matter_direct||/M_H_ref plus no-cancellation source/readout tails.
guard: requires numeric/source-backed coefficient rows if reopened
